name: Web UI
body:
A Vanilla JavaScript Web Component library with an optional Rust WebAssembly plugin.

Web UI powers every Stoic Dreams website and the Task Proxy desktop app.

name: Task Story
body: Project management for software teams that ship in short, continuous iterations. Define the problem first, try more than one solution, and keep a story of what shipped and what you dropped.

name: Task Proxy
body: A lightweight desktop app built in Rust for documentation, scripts, git, and automations kept alongside your code, with step-by-step tutorials and plugins such as Jira. For Windows, Mac, and Linux.

name: Ap Tul
body: More than 30 free, privacy-focused browser tools for images, PDFs, text, and development, from an OpenAPI viewer to a QR code generator. Your files never leave your device.
